title: Recent/persistent projects in browser: autosave to IndexedDB so F5 restores, named Save As slots + Open Recent, reopen on reload
description: DONE (task 1310). Browser-persistent projects: IndexedDB autosave (F5 restores in-progress work), named Save As slots, Open Recent, restore-on-load (+Tauri recent-paths). Storage split by size: serialized .fla bytes in IndexedDB (dash-projects DB, projects store keyPath:name; projects/projectStore.ts), active-name+recent list (cap 15, dedup) in localStorage (projects/recentProjects.ts). Debounced ~1.5s autosave via framework-free autosaveController.ts (injected timers, monotonic generation = supersession) writing reserved CURRENT-WORKING slot (__dash_current__) + active named slot. Save As writes both named+working slots and sets EditBar title. ProjectQuotaError = graceful degrade. Tauri skips IndexedDB, tracks file paths. Wired via projects/useProjectActions.ts in Shell + MenuBar (Open Recent, web Save/Save As). VERIFY: build green. authoring-ui 979 tests pass (75 files, +4 new specs = 28 tests incl quota+parse fallback). swf 1466 pass. core 5387 pass; only 3 task-1207 binary-FLA fixture failures (env: flash8-empty.fla absent), unrelated. E2E apps/desktop/e2e/persistent-projects.spec.ts = 3 passed (edit->reload->restored; Save As->reload->reopens named; plain Save updates active slot). Docs: docs/35-persistent-projects.md + README.
